page_content: The fire exit in the basement of the shopping complex near the main chowk is permanently locked with a heavy chain; this is a total death trap.
Several manhole covers are missing on the dark stretch behind the civil hospital; it's a fatal hazard for two-wheelers at night.
The emergency alarm system at the metro station near pillar 200 is malfunctioning and going off, causing a stampede-like situation among passengers.
Groups of antisocial elements are openly carrying weapons and threatening residents near the community park after 9 PM; we are terrified.
A massive iron hoarding near the busy intersection has come loose and is swaying violently; it could fall on the traffic any second.
The main gas pipeline valves near the local market are leaking and there is no security guard or fencing to prevent an accident.
The structural railing of the foot-over-bridge at the railway station is completely rusted and snapped; someone will fall onto the tracks.
Illegal firecracker storage has been found in a residential basement behind the school; the risk of a catastrophic explosion is huge.
A pack of aggressive stray dogs has cornered a group of toddlers inside the kids' play area at the park; send emergency animal control.
The panic buttons in the ladies' coach at the metro station are not responding; this is a major security failure for women's safety.
A deep trench dug for cable work near the hospital has no barricades or warning lights; a biker almost fell into it this evening.
The fire suppression system in the municipal building is showing 'System Failure' and there isn't a single working extinguisher on the floor.
Active stone-pelting is happening near the flyover junction between two groups; commuters are stuck and windows are being smashed.
A large concrete slab has detached from the ceiling of the public underpass and is dangling over the head of pedestrians.
The emergency helpline number for the city is constantly busy or unreachable during a localized fire incident.
An abandoned suitcase has been lying near the entrance of the crowded temple for 3 hours; no security personnel have checked it.
The elevator in the 10-story government office has dropped two floors suddenly and is now stuck with people screaming inside.
Live high-tension wires have snapped and fallen onto the metal boundary wall of the residential colony; the whole fence is electrified.
The height-restriction barrier at the railway underpass has collapsed and is blocking all emergency vehicles to the hospital.
Bikers are performing dangerous high-speed stunts on the main highway bridge, causing multiple cars to swerve and crash.
The chemical storage unit behind the factory has caught fire and the local residents are starting to faint from the fumes.
A landslide on the bypass road has buried half the security wall of the apartment complex; the rest is about to crumble.
A heavily intoxicated driver has rammed into the police chowki and is now threatening people with a bottle.
The public gallery for the Republic Day parade has visible structural cracks and is shaking even with a small crowd.
A swarm of thousands of bees has attacked commuters at the main bus stand; several people are unconscious.
The anti-collision barriers on the sharp hill turn are missing; any vehicle that skids will fall 50 feet into the valley.
A short circuit in the mall's security room has knocked out all surveillance and locked the electronic safety doors with people inside.
A large sinkhole has opened up right in front of the police station gate, trapping an officer's vehicle.
The bridge over the nallah is vibrating violently; we can see the foundation pillars shifting under the weight of the trucks.
Total power failure at the busy intersection has led to a massive pile-up of vehicles and people are fighting in the middle of the road.
The main CCTV camera monitoring the busy junction near the bank is broken and dangling by its wires, providing no surveillance.
The streetlights in the park behind the post office are very dim, making it a spot for alcoholics to gather after dark.
The security guard cabin at the public library is abandoned and being used by vagrants to sleep in.
Vagrants have started lighting fires inside the abandoned building near the school, causing a smoke nuisance every night.
Illegal kiosks have blocked the entire entrance to the fire station lane; the fire engines won't be able to get out in an emergency.
The 'No Entry' traffic signal near the one-way street is not working, leading to head-on traffic confusion every hour.
Unauthorized parking in the 'Emergency Ambulance Only' zone at the civil hospital is delaying patient transfers.
The boundary wall of the old graveyard is broken, allowing stray cattle and antisocial elements to enter the area at night.
Metal detectors at the mall entrance are turned off and guards are barely checking any bags; this is a major security lapse.
The police patrolling vehicle used to come at 10 PM, but we haven't seen it in our sector for over two weeks.
Street vendors have encroached on the entire sidewalk near the metro station, forcing women and children to walk on the dangerous main road.
The public address system in the market is so distorted that no one can hear the safety announcements or lost-and-found alerts.
Groups of teenagers are performing dangerous bike races inside the residential lanes of Block B every Sunday afternoon.
The gate of the children's park is broken and doesn't lock, allowing anyone to enter after midnight.
The mirror at the blind turn near the temple is cracked and blurry, making it very risky to drive out of the lane.
Loudspeakers from a private event near the clinic are exceeding the decibel limit and continuing way past the 10 PM deadline.
The emergency exit signs in the cinema hall are not illuminated; it will be impossible to find them in the dark.
Chain snatching incidents have increased near the vegetable market due to the complete lack of street lighting on that stretch.
Several abandoned cars have been parked behind the bus stand for months, becoming a hiding spot for drug addicts.
The police helpline app is crashing every time we try to upload a photo of a traffic violation.
A lot of people are drinking alcohol openly on the steps of the closed shops near the main chowk every evening.
The automatic gates at the multi-level parking lot are stuck in the open position, allowing anyone to enter without a ticket.
Streetlights in our colony are flickering like a disco, which is very disorienting for elderly people walking at night.
The CCTV control room at the community center is often found unmanned during the late night shift.
Construction debris is being dumped on the 'Safe Walk' zone near the school, forcing kids into the path of traffic.
The 'Women's Safety' kiosk at the railway station is empty and has no functional phone line or panic button.
Auto-rickshaw drivers are overcharging and misbehaving with passengers outside the mall entrance; no traffic police are present.
The fence around the local electrical transformer is broken, and stray animals are often seen wandering dangerously close.
Illegal betting rings are operating openly near the rickshaw stand, attracting a very shady crowd to the area.
The 'No Smoking' and 'No Littering' rules are being completely ignored in the public plaza, and there are no marshals to enforce them.
Requesting more frequent police patrolling in the park area during late evening hours for general safety of senior citizens.
The 'No Parking' signs near the civil hospital entrance are bent and need to be straightened for better visibility.
The glass on the security booth at the colony gate is very dirty and needs a wipe so the guard can see clearly.
The 'Police Station Ahead' signboard near the metro pillar is partially covered by a commercial poster.
Requesting an awareness board about cyber-crime and online scams at the local post office bulletin.
The paint on the police barricades kept at the main chowk has faded and they are barely visible in the dark.
A few tree branches are blocking the view of the CCTV camera installed near the primary school gate.
The 'Safety First' banner at the construction site has torn and is hanging untidily over the footpath.
Requesting a few more reflectors on the pillars of the flyover to prevent minor scrapes by vehicles.
The doorbell of the night-duty room at the police chowki is not working; people have to shout to get attention.
Some old flyers about a defunct security drive are still pasted on the walls of the community center.
The 'CCTV Under Surveillance' board in the park is slightly tilted and needs a screw fix.
Requesting a map of the nearest emergency exits to be put up in the local bazaar area.
The uniforms of the private security guards at the municipal building look very worn out; please check their contract.
One of the bollards at the pedestrian crossing near the library is loose and rattles when people lean on it.
The 'Speed Limit 30' sign near the school is dusty and hard to read from a distance.
Requesting more regular cleaning of the police booth glass near the railway station.
The lock on the fire extinguisher cabinet in the library is a bit stiff and needs oiling.
Some dry leaves have gathered around the emergency phone booth in the metro parking lot.
The yellow 'Caution' paint on the steps of the public plaza is starting to peel off.
Requesting a board showing the 'Emergency Contact Numbers' in larger font at the bus stand.
The information leaflet about fire safety provided at the apartment complex is only in English; please provide Hindi versions.
The security gate at the bank sector squeaks loudly every time it opens; needs grease.
One of the reflective tapes on the divider near the petrol pump has come off.
Requesting a better-lit sign for the 'Police Help Center' near the local mall.
The 'No Entry' sign for heavy vehicles near the narrow bridge is a bit small and often missed by drivers.
The glass covering the local area map near the metro station has some scratches on it.
Requesting an updated list of local emergency blood donors to be displayed at the community hall.
The 'Watch Your Step' sticker on the library stairs is peeling off at the corners.
A small amount of silt has gathered near the security post at the park's back gate.
